# A board example shows one set of cards in three designs

## Context

A leaf of #21346, the planning examples under #21140. The visitor's question: can a card show what our team needs: tags, people, progress, a line of text, or only a title?

No contributor labels: the capability is read from the source ([the check on `#21346`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21346#issuecomment-6982869553)) and has not been driven in a browser. A maintainer builds it, and the drive is the first step.

## The Problem

Both board examples draw the default card. A buyer judges a board by its cards, and the engine composes a card from items that a config lists.

## The Architectural Reality

- `cardItems_` (`src/board/Container.mjs:68`): the items every card renders, in order, `{type, field}` each. The types are in `src/board/CardItems.mjs`: `title` (`:40`), `text` (`:53`), `tags` (`:66`), `progress` (`:83`), `avatars` (`:109`).
- A due date can be edited and is never drawn on the card (the source check linked above).
- Template: `examples/board/basic` (not edited). Specs for the family: `test/playwright/e2e/board/`.
- Shared files stay out of this pull request (`#21539`: every examples pull request that edits them makes the others stale): the catalog's data, its two specs and `test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs` belong to #21613, which takes the record below as written.
- Design authority: n/a — a new example; it calls no existing behaviour wrong.

## The Fix

1. **Drive it first** on a scratch copy of the base example: all five item types, a change of `cardItems` at run time, and cards with missing values. A defect becomes an engine ticket, linked here as a blocker.
2. **A new folder `examples/board/cardDesigns`:** an editorial calendar. About 30 articles in Idea, Draft, Edit, Scheduled and Published, each with a section tag, an author and an editor, a standfirst and its percent done; a few without an editor or a tag. A segmented control switches between Compact (title), Standard (title, tags, avatars) and Detailed (title, text, tags, progress, avatars). The data ships with the example, in a store of models.
3. **The record, for #21613:** id `board-card-designs`, name "Card designs", `feature` "The same articles as compact, standard and detailed cards, built from five card items", `lookFor` "Switch between the three designs: the cards re-draw in place and keep their columns." Cover: the Detailed design.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The three designs switch without a reload, and each column keeps its scroll position.
- [ ] Detailed shows all five item types. A card without an editor or a tag draws without a gap and without the word "undefined".
- [ ] A spec under `test/playwright/e2e/board/` asserts the items of one card under each design.
- [ ] No console error. 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844. Every theme the base example's `neo-config.json` lists.
- [ ] **Look:** all three designs at 1440 × 900 and the first frame at 390 × 844, in the dark theme, are on the pull request beside `board/basic`'s, read cold by one reader of the builder's seat. A long title wraps to two lines and is then cut; an avatar without a picture shows initials. No control in the example's toolbar keeps its default style.
- [ ] The pull request edits no shared file.

## Out of Scope

Engine changes. A date on the card, an engine gap named on #21346. Pictures on a card. New item types.

## Avoided Traps

- **Three designs that differ by one line.** Compact and Detailed must read as two boards.
- **Data in which every card is complete.** The missing values are part of the proof.

## Related

Parent #21346 · #21140 (the Task Board row of its content table) · #21613 (publication).
